scope: Exploratory frozen-model attribution study on Wisconsin Diagnostic; specified before computing these explanations, not a preregistered confirmatory study.
models: All 21 saved models, every layout and CNN seed. Verify state hashes and reproduce all 86 saved evaluation probabilities before attribution. No model or layout refitting.
selection: First six evaluation positions of each true class, sorted by saved evaluation position. Same twelve cases for every model; retain incorrect predictions. Not selected using explanation scores.
target: True-label logit margin: (2*y-1)*(logit_M-logit_B), y=0 benign or 1 malignant. Fixed for each case across models, references, perturbations and resets. Explains support for the recorded class, not necessarily the predicted class.
reference_definition: Coordinatewise median of the 318 fit-scaled rows; alternate all-zero scaled vector (featurewise fitting minima). Encode the identical feature-space vector through each saved layout. Neither vector need represent a real patient.

integrated_gradients.refinement: Double steps until abs(sum attribution - score difference)/max(1,abs(score difference)) <= 0.001 or cap; retain and report failures.

occlusion: Captum Occlusion with sliding_window_shapes=(1,1,1), strides=1, perturbations_per_eval=30; decode to feature names and independently verify against direct single-feature replacement. Not an additive decomposition or causal effect.
agreement: Signed and absolute-magnitude Spearman plus absolute top-5 Jaccard; stable original-feature-index tie break. Constant vectors yield null for undefined metrics. Compare all cases, not selected examples.
stability: CNN seeds within each fixed layout, all three pairs
Layout seeds within each stochastic method at fixed CNN seed, all three pairs
Median versus minimum reference within each model/case
IG versus occlusion within each reference/model/case

replacement.ranking: Descending signed attribution, original-feature-index tie break. Keep k fixed, record number of positive scores; constant signed maps ineligible.
replacement.reference: Match each attribution's reference. Replace in feature space then re-encode.
replacement.random_control: Identical feature subsets for all models and references at a case/k; seed + evaluation position. Sampling without replacement within each subset.
replacement.outcome: Original fixed target score minus replaced score. Retain all random drops; report excess over random mean, fraction above random mean and midrank random percentile. Percentile is descriptive, not a p-value. Raw logit scales differ across models.

randomization.condition: Full untrained SmallGridCNN reset for each saved model, seed=cnn_seed+9100; same reset weights across layouts sharing CNN seed
randomization.scope: Limited parameter-dependence diagnostic, not the full Adebayo et al. suite; no retraining or label randomization.

reference_only_control: Compare IG magnitude ranks with absolute input-minus-reference difference; this vector uses no model weights. Descriptive agreement only.
reporting: Save per-model/case/reference vectors and diagnostics, pairwise comparisons and all seeds. Means are descriptive; 252 model-case observations are not 252 independent patients. Plot all model or pair means, not significance intervals. Illustrations use the first selected case and first CNN/layout seeds, not a best-looking map.
limits: Only twelve selected, previously examined evaluation cases from one small morphology dataset
Replacement and IG paths can leave the correlated-feature data distribution
Occlusion and replacement share the intervention, so their agreement is not independent validation
No Grad-CAM regional-to-feature proxy, SHAP/LIME rerun, new tabular baseline, genomic evaluation, biological claim, clinical claim or novelty claim
No further fitting or tuning on observed scores; exclude the previous 86 learning-test rows from transforms and scoring
